column2:
목욕중인 숙녀를 훔쳐보려 하다니, 냉큼 꺼지지 못할까…,
"여기가 감히 어딘 줄이나 알고 들어온 거냐?",
"가거라, 나의 귀여운 아이들아. 가서 놈들을 영원한 어둠 속으로 인도하거라.",
"조금만 기다리거라. 나의 마력이 거의 다 차 올랐으니…",
"나의 충성스런 아이들아, 가서 목욕통에 담을 피를 보충해 오거라.",
"너희들의 충성심을 내게 보여주거라.",
"쯧쯧쯧… 무모하다고나 할까, 어리석다고나 할까…",
"크크?, 그래도 살아보겠다고 발버둥을 치는구나.",
"좀 더 힘을 내보라구. 이제 시작일 뿐인데 그렇게까지 숨을 몰아 쉬어서야…",
"내가 브리콜라카스님께 배운 건 마법만이 아니란 걸 알게 될 거야."
column3:
Peeping at a lady in her bath? Get out this instant...,
"Do you even know where you have dared to set foot?",
"Go, my lovely children. Go and lead them into eternal darkness.",
"Wait just a little longer. My magic is almost at its peak...",
"My loyal children, go and bring more blood to fill my bath.",
"Show me your loyalty.",
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... Is it recklessness, or simple stupidity...",
"Heh heh, still thrashing about trying to stay alive.",
"Try a little harder. This is only the beginning, and already you gasp for breath...",
"You will learn that magic is not all Lord Vrykolakas taught me."

column2:
대체 어느 놈이냐… 바깥이 무척 소란스럽구나.,
"아직 두려움이란 걸 경험치 못한 생쥐들이 숨어들었나 보군.",
"나의 숙면을 방해한 죄의 댓가는 죽음보다 크다는 걸 알아라.",
"조금만 참고 견디거라. 너희들을 이내 피의 축제 속으로 초대할 테니.",
"하하하하… 고작 이 정도에 얼굴색이 변하는 거냐?",
"끌끌끌… 이따금은 이런 멍청이들이라도 생겨야 사는데 재미가 있을 테지.",
"혹시 지금 사전이 있거들랑 '만용'이란 단어 뜻을 찾아 보라구.",
"에슬라니아에 숨겨진 일족의 힘은 곧 나의 것이 되리라.",
"벌써부터 그렇게 나가떨어져서야 내 모습은 구경도 못해볼 거 아닌가.",
"나를 좀더 흥겹게 해주지 못하면 곤란한데 말이야…"
column3:
Who goes there... There is quite a commotion outside.,
"It seems some mice who have yet to learn fear have crept in.",
"Know that the price for disturbing my slumber is greater than death.",
"Be patient a little longer. I shall soon invite you to a feast of blood.",
"Hahahaha... Is this enough to make you turn pale?",
"Heh heh heh... Now and then it takes fools like these to keep life amusing.",
"If you have a dictionary on you, look up the word 'recklessness'.",
"The power of the clan hidden in Eslania shall soon be mine.",
"If you fall so soon, you will never even get to see my face.",
"It would be a pity if you could not entertain me a little better..."

column2:
피 속에 흐르는 불멸의 힘이 언젠가 너희를 죽음으로 인도할 것이다.,
"들리느냐? 나의 수하들이 울부짖는 소리가… 일족의 저주가 늘 그림자에 붙어 다닐 것이다.",
"이번에는 물러서겠다만, 언젠가 네놈의 살은 비누로 만들고 피는 목욕통에 담아주겠다."
column3:
The immortal power flowing in my blood will one day lead you to your deaths.,
"Do you hear it? The wailing of my servants... The curse of my clan will cling to your shadow forever.",
"I will withdraw this time, but one day I will make soap of your flesh and fill my bath with your blood."

column2:
크윽… 내가 하필 부상 중일 때 덤비다니… 운 좋은 줄 알아라, 꼬마.,
"앞으론 명당자리로만 골라다녀라. 다음에 마주쳤을 땐 그 자리가 곧 네 무덤이 될 테니…",
"낯짝을 똑똑히 기억해두마. 언젠가 네놈 엉덩이에 꼬챙이를 꿰어 매달아 주어야 할 테니…"
column3:
Ugh... To strike at me just when I am wounded... Count yourself lucky, boy.,
"From now on, keep to the safest ground you can find. The next place we meet will be your grave...",
"I will remember your face well. One day I must hang you up with a skewer through your backside..."

column2:
누가 보낸 것이냐? 네 놈들도 테페즈의 개란 말이냐? 빌어먹을 자식… 언젠간 내 손으로…,
"뱀파이어의 긍지를 잃은 어리석은 것들아, 일족의 저주가 늘 그림자에 붙어 다닐 것이다.",
"네 놈의 피에 흐르는 생명은 누구의 것이란 말이냐? 은혜도 모르는 어리석은 녀석들…"
column3:
Who sent you? Are you Tepes's dogs too? Curse you... One day, with my own hands...,
"Fools who have lost the pride of Vampires, the curse of the clan will cling to your shadow forever.",
"Whose life is it that flows in your blood? Ungrateful fools..."

column2:
조무래기 배신자들에게 당할 줄이야. 두고 봐라. 다음 번엔 그리 쉽지 않을 것이다.,
"내게 바쳤던 충성의 서약은 거짓이었단 말이냐? 불멸의 육신이 언젠가 너희들을 반드시 멸하리라.",
"바토리를 해치우기는커녕 되려 내게 칼날을 들이대다니… 배신의 대가는 죽음보다 클 것이다."
column3:
To be brought down by petty traitors. Mark my words. Next time it will not be so easy.,
"Was the oath of loyalty you swore to me a lie? My immortal flesh will destroy you all one day.",
"Instead of finishing off Bathory, you turn your blades on me... The price of betrayal will be greater than death."

column2: 어리석은 녀석들. 지옥에서나 너희들의 나약함에 눈물을 흘리거라.,\n"깔깔깔깔... 고작 그 정도의 힘으로 이 안에 발을 들여놓았단 말이냐?",\n"이제 와서 발바닥을 핥으며 빌어봐야 소용없지 않겠어? 크크큭"
column3: Fools. Go and weep over your weakness in hell.,\n"Ahahahaha... You dared set foot in here with so little power?",\n"What good will it do now to lick my feet and beg? Heh heh heh"

column2:
네 녀석들의 기막힌 용기에 경의를 표한다. 가급적 고통 없이 보내주도록 하지.,
"하하하하. 꼬챙이에 꿸 장식품들이 많이도 늘었구나.",
"귀여운 녀석들. 네놈들에게도 생각이란 게 있다면 다신 이곳에 올 엄두를 못 내겠지?"
column3:
I salute your remarkable courage. I shall try to send you off without pain.,
"Hahahaha. My collection of skewered ornaments has grown nicely.",
"Adorable creatures. If you have any sense at all, you will never dare come here again."

column2: No wonder it's so noisy outside?? Did you get through those horrible traps to arrive here?
column3: No wonder it is so noisy outside... Did you really get past those horrible traps?

column2: Please don't be mistaken. Although I have settled here, I'm not clear the origin of those traps.
column3: Do not misunderstand. I may have settled here, but I do not know where those traps came from.

column2: I'm also obssessed by the traps?? it's a mystery who created them.
column3: The traps trouble me too... Who built them is a mystery.

column2: Wait, there must be something to appear. Is it you guys who do this? Do you guys want to hurt me?
column3: Wait, something is about to appear. Is this your doing? Do you mean to harm me?

column2: Don't you do that? Anyway, you are all strong warriors.
column3: No? Well, you are all strong warriors, in any case.

column2: You guys make me think about a girl named Jendaluke
column3: You remind me of a girl named Jendaluke.

column2: Her power is the greatest. I was getting to respect her when she visited me for saving her nation.
column3: Her power was the greatest. I came to respect her when she visited me, seeking to save her nation.

column2: She is so young to be here for saving the nation.
column3: She was so young to come all this way to save her nation.

column2: Why are you guys visiting me? You should know that it's very dangerous here.
column3: Why have you come to me? You should know it is very dangerous here.

column2: Now I'm so headache that I cannot help you for the moment.
column3: My head aches so badly that I cannot help you just now.

column2: Well, you should not have ejected these guests who were asking for help. It's so rude.
column3: Well, it was rude of me to turn away guests who came asking for help.

column2: Please don't blame me. The old make such mistakes sometimes. After a while, watch the ballon go up,hahaha!
column3: Do not blame me. The old make such mistakes now and then. Now watch the balloon go up, hahaha!

column2: I really cannot stand the fragrance from your guys.
column3: I really cannot stand the smell of you.

column2: It's a humiliation that I'm defeated by you guys.
column3: What a humiliation, to be beaten by the likes of you.

column2: It's dangerous here. Get out of here?? Oh, I can't hold on.
column3: It is dangerous here. Get out... Oh, I cannot hold on.

column2: Well! I felt so bad?? You guys' expressions are so ridiculous. I'd like to play more tricks on you more.
column3: Well! How awful I feel... The looks on your faces are priceless. I would love to play more tricks on you.

column2: Stop! Stop attack! I didn't mean to. Well?? I thought everything was well, but evilness still exists, cannot get rid of.
column3: Stop! Stop attacking! I did not mean it. Well... I thought all was well, but the evil still lingers. I cannot be rid of it.

column2: Things which have happened cannot be redeemed. Do you want to make a compromise with me now ?
column3: What is done cannot be undone. Will you come to terms with me now?

column2: The power which Jendaluke wanted to have?? Don't you want to know?
column3: The power Jendaluke wanted... Do you not want to know?

column2: Then, Jendaluke refused my request. However, I believe you will not absolutely.
column3: Jendaluke refused my request. But I am sure you will not.

column2: Then, I gave her the power she wanted at the expense of her flesh and blood. I don't think the requirement is high.
column3: So I gave her the power she wanted, at the price of her flesh and blood. I hardly think that was asking much.

column2: I was hurt badly so I decided to cut off all connections with outside. That's why I designed all of these traps.
column3: I was badly hurt, so I cut myself off from the outside world. That is why I built all these traps.

column2: I abandoned all my own glories!
column3: I cast aside all my own glory!

column2: Look! I created lives with my power. You all can get renascence.
column3: Look! I have created life with my power. You can all be reborn.

column2: Ah? What's wrong? Is it not enough? If no human child's blood, perfect life cannot be created!
column3: Ah? What is wrong? Is it not enough? Without a human child's blood, perfect life cannot be made!

column2: Once we had Jendaluke's blood?? By the way, try some of your blood, although it's not that pure.
column3: Once we had Jendaluke's blood... Still, let me taste yours, though it is not so pure.

column2: I will creat perfect life. Your blood is flowing in my body, you guys should be feel proud.
column3: I will create perfect life. Your blood flows in my body; you should be proud.

column2: The blood of like you guys??. You don't need to feel sorry. I'll take care of everything.
column3: Blood like yours... Do not be sorry. I will take care of everything.

column2: I really don't understand, why are you feeling so hopeful for life? Anyway, everybody will die, turning to dust
column3: I truly do not understand why you cling to life so hopefully. Everyone dies and turns to dust in the end.

column2: You'd better go back. It's good for you.
column3: You had better go back. It is for your own good.

column2: I warned you, it's a dangerous place. Now, I'm?? Ah??
column3: I warned you this was a dangerous place. Now I am... Ah...

column2: Ahaha, the shell is finally removed.
column3: Ahaha, the shell is finally off.

column2: Magic was used for bringing you memorable things. But now, it seems no useful.
column3: Magic was once used to bring you things worth remembering. Now it seems to be of no use.

column2: Have you guys ever seen that? This is a real masterwork. Look at yourselves who are fighting with illusions, so poor.
column3: Have you ever seen the like? This is a true masterpiece. Look at you, fighting illusions. How pitiful.

column2: How's your feeling? Is it great to be tricked?
column3: How does it feel? Is it fun being tricked?

column2: No, please, please let me go!
column3: No, please, please let me go!

column2: From now on, nothing is illusion.
column3: From now on, nothing is an illusion.

column2: I'm tired of people who play double characters or things like just waiting for food.
column3: I am tired of two-faced people, and of those who just sit and wait to be fed.

column2: 以前说起宝刀的话一般都是指由少数技艺精湛的匠人制造而成的，不过大量增加的需求使许多军工业体选择了刀剑制造这一行。其中以S&W师的试作品作为标准，规格化成为SWMS 3000，统称为“针刃”。无属性 150专用
column3: Fine blades were once made only by a handful of master smiths, but rising demand drew many arms makers into swordmaking. A prototype by S&W became the standard, the SWMS 3000, known to all as the "Niddle Edger". No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 尺寸跟人的个子差不多，所以需要两只手一起使用，所以叫它双手卡博。它的刀刃很宽很厚，所以重量很高，单纯地挥动它，破坏力也是很高的。因为能使用的人并不多，所以它的数量是很有限的。无属性 150专用
column3: Nearly as tall as a man, it can only be wielded with both hands, hence the name Duocarpo. Its broad, thick blade makes it very heavy, so even a simple swing is devastating. Few can wield it, so very few exist. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 在Grant手中的显赫阿赛也是强调威压感的形态，它并不使用于直接的价格。不过由于它是用无属性物质金属构成的，所以把Grant们的魔法力能有效地传达，因此它们的作用是可以充分地得到认可。无属性 150专用
column3: In the hands of the Granters, the Salience Asser takes an imposing form, yet it is not meant for direct blows. Made of attribute-free metal, it channels the Granters' magic well, and its worth is fully recognized. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 针对吸血鬼和魔灵的物理攻击,一般多为割和刺这一点制作而成的盾牌。它的边缘用很厚实的钛合金制作，可以很好的防御从侧面过来的袭击。另外为了弥补相对薄弱的中央部分，还钉上了金属突起。无属性 150专用
column3: A shield designed around the fact that Vampire and Ousters physical attacks are mostly cuts and thrusts. Its rim of thick titanium alloy fends off blows from the side, and metal studs reinforce the thinner center. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 装备了全套 TA/FCS系统，在夜间或恶劣天气下也可以发现炮塔，还可以计算出瞄准时必要的数字给使用者的终端机上做标记。无属性 150专用
column3: Fitted with an integrated TA/FCS system, it can spot targets at night or in foul weather and marks the figures needed for aiming on the user's terminal. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 用一般的十字架或者不同形态的十字架来表示自己的身份，按照信念因为是他们独立使用的十字架所以名称叫信仰者。无属性 150专用
column3: Named for the believers who show who they are with a cross of their own faith, whether a plain cross or one of another shape. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 毛瑟类的闩锁式连发来复枪。由于毛瑟枪种类特有的无旋转的膛线，因为跟装进部分较长，比较容易迅速而正确的射中。所以在战场上的可造性很高。无属性 150专用
column3: A Mauser-type bolt-action repeating rifle. Its long action and the rifling typical of Mauser guns make fast, accurate shots easy, so it is highly prized on the battlefield. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 以防弹为基本设计的这款产品,对敌人特殊生命体吸血鬼来说没有效果,从这一点来着眼开的,确保视野,主力放在通讯技能的产品,不过构造自身的强度很高,所以对侧颈部也可以提供一定程度的保护.它的重量相对较轻,所以总体评价很好.无属性 150专用
column3: Earlier headgear was built to stop bullets, which is useless against Vampires. This model focuses on clear vision and communications instead, yet its sturdy frame also shields the side of the neck. Being fairly light, it is well regarded overall. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 年轻的吸血鬼们穿着跟大师比起来风度略逊，但加强敏捷性的服装，表现出想要摆脱大师们的阴影的意图。无属性 150男鬼专用
column3: Less stately than a master's coat but made for agility, it is worn by young Vampires who mean to step out of their masters' shadow. No attribute. Level 150, male Vampires only.

column2: 吸血鬼特有的迷人的魅力已经被他们强有力的武器认可了。特别是女性吸血鬼的魅力，即使是连他们对手的警戒性都不放过。刚生下来的小吸血鬼则需要能够有效地活用这些优点的衣裳。用薄皮质裁剪后层层缝纫的衣裳可以有效地防御银子弹和剑的攻击。无属性 150女鬼专用
column3: A Vampire's bewitching charm is a proven weapon, and a female Vampire's can disarm even a wary foe. Newborn Vampires need clothing that makes the most of it. Cut from thin leather and sewn in layers, it guards well against silver bullets and blades. No attribute. Level 150, female Vampires only.

column2: 棱爪又细又长的刀刃可以穿过对方的厚厚的手套深入对方身体内。并且大弧度的设计使遭到攻击的对方无法轻易逃脱，即使逃脱了，身体也会留下很大的伤口，痛苦不堪。不过一部分人因为这个武器导致猎物的出血过多，而实际上能自己吃到的血很少而感到不满。无属性 150鬼专用
column3: Its long, slender blades pierce even thick gloves to reach deep into the body, and their wide curve keeps the prey from slipping free; any who escape carry gaping wounds. Some complain the prey bleeds so much that little blood is left to drink. No attribute. Level 150, Vampires only.

column2: 被选拔为战士的魔灵们抛弃了明亮而清澈的气氛，不得不自己去寻求黑暗。他们的衣裳颜色是统一的象征死亡的紫色。无属性 150专用
column3: The Ousters chosen as warriors cast aside their bright, clear nature and had to seek out darkness. They all dress in purple, the color of death. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 被选拔为战士的魔灵们抛弃了明亮而清澈的气氛，不得不自己去寻求黑暗。他们的衣裳颜色是统一的象征死亡的紫色。紫色既可以表示死亡又可以表示高贵的灵魂，也是可以对死神表示把自己完全交付给他的意思。无属性 150专用
column3: The Ousters chosen as warriors cast aside their bright, clear nature and had to seek out darkness. They all dress in purple, the color of death. Purple stands for both death and a noble soul, and for giving oneself wholly to the god of death. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 悲哀的精灵梅利斯是装着力量的轮，它可以吸收牺牲者的痛苦和悲哀，从而变得更厉害。有着4根角度不同的刺，所以哪怕只受到一次攻击的人也够受的。无属性 150专用
column3: A ring holding the power of Melis, spirit of sorrow, that grows deadlier as it absorbs its victims' pain and grief. Its four spikes, set at different angles, make even a single hit hard to bear. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 用古代巨人的骨头加工制成。人们认为古代的世界是用巨人来构成的。他们叫做堕落精灵。他们的力量相当于一般精灵的两倍。不过由于他们邪恶的气息，为了防止对使用者产生副作用，所以在表面雕刻了些纹章。无属性 150专用
column3: Crafted from the bones of ancient giants, the Nephilim, who were believed to make up the ancient world and were twice as strong as ordinary spirits. Crests are carved on its surface to shield the wearer from their evil aura. No attribute. Level 150 only.

column2: 原定在 E.V.E.的计划中要开发的装备。体积很大，不过是用多层的纤维制成的，所以重量很轻。参照突击敌人时离敌人最近的身体部分――肩膀为保护对象来制作的，表面的突起利用了可以用来进行攻击。不过对比人类动作灵敏的吸血鬼和魔灵是并不是那么简单的。样子像蛤蟆的背部，所以被称为“蛤蟆背”。
column3: Gear originally planned for EVE's heavy infantry. Bulky but light thanks to its multilayered fiber, it protects the shoulders, the part closest to the enemy in a charge, and its studs can be used to strike. Against agile Vampires and Ousters, though, that is easier said than done. It looks like a toad's back, hence the name "Toad Back".

column2: 过去阿拉伯的死刑执行者使用过这个面具，用来挡住受死刑者的怨恨。一直以来这个面具包含着无数受死刑的人们的怨恨和恐惧。在面具里喷发出来的恐惧感使那些看到面具的人们丧失战意。
column3: A mask once worn by Arab executioners to ward off the grudges of the condemned. It holds the resentment and terror of countless executed souls, and the fear pouring from it robs all who see it of the will to fight.

column2: 叫vt的天主教直属组织的神父们使用的保护装备。用皮革做手套，外面加板金，提高防御力和活动性。装饰着神父专用的豪华装饰，这个装饰做的相当不错，很华丽，但手腕部位用白布做成，防御力会降低。手腕部位白布上用红血写着圣书的字句。“我赐予你智慧和权能让你打败恶魔，你们要勇敢的抵抗，我会永远跟你们在一起。”虽然防御力不怎么样，但是具有圣力的手套。
column3: Protective gloves of the priests of the Vatican Knights, a Slayer order under the Catholic Church. Leather plated with metal for defense and mobility, with lavish priestly ornaments. The wrists are white cloth, which weakens them, and on it scripture is written in red blood: "I give you wisdom and power to defeat the devil. Resist bravely, and I will be with you always." Weak in defense, but blessed with holy power.
